title: Smoluchowski-Kramers Approximation with Levy Noise in the Meyer-Zheng Topology: tightness of the slow and transformed families in the Meyer-Zheng topology (Lemma 3.5)
author: Xueru Liu, Qianqian Jiang, Wei Wang
work: Smoluchowski-Kramers approximation with Levy noise in the Meyer-Zheng topology
difficulty_reason: Counted unit: the paper's tightness lemma for the slow variable and the transformed variable in the Meyer-Zheng topology, printed as Lemma 3.5 (source0.tex lines 1201-1206) and delivered with the paper's own complete 130-line proof (lines 1208-1337). The statement gives, under the paper's three standing assumptions, the tightness in the Meyer-Zheng topology of the laws of both the slow component and the transformed process, uniformly over the small-mass parameter. The proof is the paper's own: it controls the slow variable in the energy norm through a priori estimates, uses the conditional-variation bound retained as context to obtain the tightness of the transformed family, and then applies a Meyer-Zheng tightness criterion that replaces the usual compactness of the time increments by a bound on the conditional variation together with the tightness of the time marginals. This is a research-level stochastic-analysis argument about a singular perturbation limit with jump noise rather than a qualifying-examination exercise, so the unit is H2. Delivered with the paper's own proof, in the paper's own notation, as the single primary proof body; the unit is H2.
